key_insight: Forecasting models handle familiar intervention values well but struggle with unseen values, making novel scenario generalization the central challenge.
engineering_relevance: WhatIf-Bench tests whether forecasters can support what-if planning in data centers, power grids, road traffic, and water networks.
method: Generate semi-synthetic time series using mechanistic simulators with controlled covariate–target relationships.
Forecast future interventions that reuse historical covariate values (Replay) or introduce unseen values (Novel).
Vary covariate count, historical event count, and event length; compare TSFMs, frontier LLMs, and regression baselines.
evidence_signal: Across 37,665 tasks, skill relative to a naive baseline ranges from 48–85% on Replay to −7–50% on Novel futures, with frontier LLMs achieving the highest skill.
watch_item: The benchmark is semi-synthetic, so performance does not establish reliability for real-world interventions beyond the simulated systems.
paper_title: WhatIf-Bench: Benchmarking Intervention-Aware Time Series Forecasting
